samples.xml_description:
<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>Asynchronous FIFO implementation with configurable depth and width parameters.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock signal used for synchronous write operations.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock signal used for synchronous read operations.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset signal. Active low.</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset signal. Active low.</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment signal. Triggered when write operation is enabled.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment signal. Triggered when read operation is enabled.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write data input. Data to be written into the FIFO.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Write full signal. Indicates if the FIFO is full and cannot accept further write operations.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Read empty signal. Indicates if the FIFO is empty and cannot provide any data for read operations.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read data output. Data read from the FIFO.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <param id="WIDTH">Data width parameter. Specifies the width of the data input and output ports.</param>
        <param id="DEPTH">Depth parameter. Defines the capacity of the FIFO.</param>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        // Define internal signals
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] RAM_MEM[0:DEPTH-1];
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] rdata;
        reg [3:0] waddr_bin, raddr_bin;
        reg [3:0] wptr, rptr, wptr_buff, rptr_buff, wptr_syn, rptr_syn;
        // Combinational logic for reading data
        always@(*) begin
            if(renc && !rempty)
                rdata <= RAM_MEM[raddr_bin];
        end
        
        // Convert binary to gray code
        function [3:0] bin_to_gray(input [3:0] bin);
            bin_to_gray = bin ^ (bin >> 1);
        endfunction
        // Convert gray code to binary
        function [3:0] gray_to_bin(input [3:0] gray);
            integer i;
            gray_to_bin = gray;
            for(i=0;i<=3;i=i+1) begin
                gray_to_bin[i] = gray_to_bin[i] ^ gray_to_bin[i+1];
            end
        endfunction
        // Sequential logic for writing data
        always@(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn)begin
            if(~wrstn) begin
                waddr_bin <= 0;
                wptr <= 0;
            end else begin
                if(winc & !wfull) begin
                    RAM_MEM[waddr_bin] <= wdata;
                    waddr_bin <= waddr_bin + 1;
                    wptr <= bin_to_gray(waddr_bin + 1);
                end else begin
                    waddr_bin <= waddr_bin;
                    wptr <= wptr;
                end
            end
        end
        // Sequential logic for read pointer synchronization
        always@(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn)begin
            if(~wrstn) begin
                rptr_syn <= 0;
                rptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                rptr_syn <= rptr;
                rptr_buff <= rptr_syn;
            end
        end
        // Sequential logic for write pointer synchronization
        always@(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn)begin
            if(~rrstn) begin
                wptr_syn <= 0;
                wptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr_syn <= wptr;
                wptr_buff <= wptr_syn;
            end
        end
        // Sequential logic for reading data
        always@(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn)begin
            if(~rrstn) begin
                raddr_bin <= 0;
                rptr <= 0;
            end else begin
                if(rinc & !rempty) begin
                    raddr_bin <= raddr_bin + 1;
                    rptr <= bin_to_gray(raddr_bin + 1);
                end else begin
                    raddr_bin <= raddr_bin;
                    rptr <= rptr;
                end
            end
        end
        // Full and empty condition checking
        assign wfull = (wptr == {~rptr_buff[3], rptr_buff[2:0]});
        assign rempty = (rptr == wptr_buff);
        
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>
        // Dual-port RAM instance
        dual_port_RAM #(.DEPTH(DEPTH), .WIDTH(WIDTH)) ram(
            .wclk(wclk),
            .rclk(rclk),
            .wenc(winc & ~wfull),
            .renc(rinc & ~rempty),
            .waddr(waddr_bin),
            .raddr(raddr_bin),
            .wdata(wdata),
            .rdata(rdata)
        );
    </implementation>
</module>
